description: Make a faceless video from an idea or a script, with no footage: the style’s pictures, designed screens, captions and sound. Send exactly one of idea (Clypmint writes the narration) or script (spoken exactly as supplied), which sets the length, so leave seconds out. Defaults to a 30-second vertical video; seconds may be 15, 30 or 60. Take the style from browse_styles and follow its inputs: Serif Editorial Launch is format: motion with inputs.voice:none (no narrator unless the user asks for a voiceover); Bold Navy Statement is narrated, with Chris by default; a format: talking style needs footage (edit_video). Optional: formats (the main shape first), voice (one of 21 narrators by name), sound_effects (on unless false), music_bed (the style’s music under the voice, only when true), pictures (asset_ids, or asset_staging_keys from import_asset), a song (music_staging_key), purpose and instructions. For several videos use create_videos; for a month of posts, plan_content. Cost: 3 credits to make, plus 1 for each started minute of voice-over and 1 for each started minute of finished video after the first, plus 2 for each extra format; dry_run: true answers the cost and starts nothing. Answers with studio_url: follow it with check_video. Never posts.

asset_ids.description: Pictures or clips already in Clypmint to show (src_... from list_assets or save_clip).

asset_staging_keys.description: Pictures the user wants shown (a portrait, a product, an app screen), each imported with import_asset.

dry_run.description: true: answer the credit cost and start nothing.

format.description: The older one-shape switch; formats says more.

formats.description: Every shape to make, the main one first: 9:16, 16:9, 1:1, 4:5.

idea.description: What the video is about, in a line or two: Clypmint writes the narration.

instructions.description: Anything else the user asked for, in their own words (where each picture goes, the tone); not what has its own field, and no rule lists. A link here is not opened: import a picture with import_asset.

music_bed.description: true: lay the style's own music bed under the narration (none unless asked); false: never. music_staging_key brings a song of your own instead.

music_staging_key.description: A song from import_asset (mp3, wav or m4a) to lay under the voice.

operation_id.description: The same id on a retry runs it once; a new id is a new request.

purpose.description: organic (a post), ad (three openings by default), youtube (horizontal), sales_page.

script.description: The exact words to narrate, read as written. Send script or idea, not both.

seconds.description: How long: 15, 30 or 60. With a script, leave it out: the script sets the length (about 2.5 words a second; at most 43 words for 15, 86 for 30, 172 for 60).

style_id.description: A style id from browse_styles (my-... for the user's own).

style_version.description: A saved version of the user's own style; its newest when left out.

title.description: The video's name in the user's library.

voice.description: The narrator for a video made from words (sarah: calm, health and money; alice: clear British educator; brian: deep documentary; liam: energetic ads; browse_styles describes all 21). Left out: the style's own narrator, or one that fits the words.

name: create_video

outputSchema.description: Clypmint create_video result. Error results carry error; successful requests expose the identifiers and state available for the next step. Signed media stays in private metadata.

title: Make a faceless video
